svg.title: Autoencoder + ANN surrogate architecture for EV e-machine eMag force prediction
svg.desc: Two-phase training: Phase 1 trains encoder-decoder autoencoder on raw force data. Phase 2 freezes decoder and trains ANN surrogate to map operating conditions to latent features. At inference the encoder is removed.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What shape is the raw force input tensor for 48 stator teeth?')
sendPrompt('What layers should I use in the encoder for electromagnetic force compression?')
sendPrompt('How do I choose the latent dimension size for the eMag force autoencoder?')
sendPrompt('What decoder architecture reconstructs 48 tooth forces from the latent vector?')
sendPrompt('How do I compute reconstruction loss for the eMag force autoencoder?')

svg.text: Phase 2 — ANN surrogate training (encoder frozen & discarded)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I encode electrical angle for the ANN surrogate input?')
sendPrompt('What ANN architecture should I use to map operating conditions to the autoencoder latent space?')
sendPrompt('How do I train the ANN to match the encoder latent codes?')
sendPrompt('How do I freeze the decoder weights during ANN surrogate training?')

svg.text: Inference — encoder removed, ANN feeds decoder directly

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me inference code for predicting forces at a new operating point')
sendPrompt('Show me inference code for the ANN surrogate model')
sendPrompt('Show me inference code for the frozen decoder producing tooth forces')
sendPrompt('What is the output shape of the decoded electromagnetic force prediction?')
